<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will apply retrosynthetic template 1914391 to the product molecule. I will use the product SMILES extracted from the mapped reaction, preserving the stereochemistry symbols (@ and @@) so that RDKit can parse it correctly.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCOC(=O)CH2C@H1CH2C@H(OH)C@@H(CH3)C@@H(/CH=C(/CH3)C(=O)OC)O1",
    "template_id": "1914391"
}</action_input>
